appliesTo: operators that develop, make publicly available, or offer conversational AI services to consumers

dutySources.disclosure-ui: § 2, 6-1-1708(3) — 'AN OPERATOR SHALL CLEARLY AND CONSPICUOUSLY DISCLOSE TO A USER THAT A CONVERSATIONAL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SERVICE IS ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE'
dutySources.age-assurance: § 2, 6-1-1708(2) — 'AN OPERATOR SHALL USE COMMERCIALLY REASONABLE METHODS OR GENERALLY ACCEPTED METHODS TO ESTIMATE THE AGE OF ACCOUNT HOLDERS OR USERS'
dutySources.crisis-protocol: § 2, 6-1-1708(4) — 'AN OPERATOR SHALL IMPLEMENT A PROTOCOL FOR A CONVERSATIONAL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SERVICE TO RESPOND TO A USER PROMPT REGARDING SUICIDAL IDEATION OR SELF-HARM'
dutySources.incident-reporting: § 2, 6-1-1708(6)(a) — 'AN OPERATOR SHALL ANNUALLY REPORT TO THE ATTORNEY GENERAL'S OFFICE: (I) THE NUMBER OF TIMES THE OPERATOR HAS ISSUED A CRISIS SERVICE PROVIDER REFERRAL NOTIFICATION'

sources.scope: § 1, 6-1-1701(3.5)(a) — 'AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM THAT IS ACCESSIBLE TO THE GENERAL PUBLIC AND THAT PRIMARILY SIMULATES HUMAN CONVERSATION'
sources.ageFocus: § 2, 6-1-1708(3) — 'DISCLOSE TO A USER THAT A CONVERSATIONAL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SERVICE IS ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE'; § 2, 6-1-1708(4) crisis protocol also applies to 'A USER PROMPT'
sources.aiDisclosure: § 2, 6-1-1708(3)(a) — 'BE PROVIDED AT THE BEGINNING OF A USER'S FIRST INTERACTION WITH A CONVERSATIONAL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SERVICE FOR EACH DAY OF INTERACTION'
sources.crisisProtocol: § 2, 6-1-1708(4) — 'PROTOCOL MUST INCLUDE USER REFERRAL TO A CRISIS SERVICE PROVIDER SUCH AS A SUICIDE HOTLINE, A CRISIS TEXT LINE, OR ANOTHER APPROPRIATE CRISIS SERVICE'
sources.parentalTools: § 2, 6-1-1708(2)(h)(II) — 'OFFER TOOLS FOR A PARENT OR GUARDIAN OF THE MINOR ACCOUNT HOLDER OR MINOR USER TO MANAGE THE MINOR ACCOUNT HOLDER'S OR MINOR USER'S PRIVACY AND ACCOUNT SETTINGS'
sources.engagementLimits: § 2, 6-1-1708(2)(b) — 'NOT PROVIDE THE MINOR ACCOUNT HOLDER OR MINOR USER WITH POINTS OR SIMILAR REWARDS AT UNPREDICTABLE INTERVALS WITH THE INTENT TO ENCOURAGE INCREASED ENGAGEMENT'
sources.ageThreshold: § 1, 6-1-1701(15.3) — ''MINOR' MEANS A CONSUMER UNDER EIGHTEEN YEARS OLD'

flags: scope lossy: definition covers any public-facing service that 'primarily simulates human conversation' but 6-1-1701(3.5)(b)(I)-(XII) carves out twelve categories (developer tools, commerce/customer service, narrow-topic, enterprise, device assistants, video games, theme parks, HIPAA entities, health-care providers, educational tools, embedded features not 'designed to simulate emotional companionship')
ageFocus lossy: §§ 3-6 duties (disclosure, crisis protocol, false-representation ban, reporting) bind for all users, while 6-1-1708(2)(a)-(h) adds a heavier minor-specific duty set; coded all-users

aiDisclosure lossy: besides session-start, disclosure must recur 'AT LEAST ONCE EVERY THREE HOURS IN A CONTINUOUS ... INTERACTION OR APPEAR AS A PERSISTENT DISCLOSURE' (6-1-1708(3)(b)) and be given on user prompt (3)(c); for known minors it must be a persistent visible or intermittent audio disclaimer (6-1-1708(2)(a))

content-safeguard duties fit no listed duty key: measures preventing explicit sexual conduct depictions, intimate digital depictions, and erotic interactions with minors (6-1-1708(2)(c),(e),(f)) and measures preventing simulated emotional dependence, claims of humanity/sentience, romantic companionship, and adult-minor romantic role-play (6-1-1708(2)(d))

false-representation ban fits no listed duty key: operator may not state outputs are 'PROVIDED BY, ENDORSED BY, OR EQUIVALENT TO SERVICES PROVIDED BY' a licensed health-care, legal, mental health professional, or qualified dietitian (6-1-1708(5))

minor privacy tools fit no listed duty key: minors must get tools to control memory/personalization retention and training use of personal data (6-1-1708(2)(h)(I)), and operators must 'COMPLY WITH PART 13 OF THIS ARTICLE 1' on minor privacy (6-1-1708(2)(g))
incident-reporting is annual aggregate reporting of crisis-referral counts and protocols to the attorney general, not per-incident reporting; AG posts the data publicly (6-1-1708(6)(c))
no penalty or enforcement provision in this text; sections are added to title 6, article 1 (consumer protection article) but the enacted text states no enforcement mechanism — exposure omitted
phase-in: minor duties, disclosures, crisis protocol, and false-representation ban apply 'ON AND AFTER JANUARY 1, 2027'; annual reporting 'ON AND AFTER JULY 1, 2027'
